title: SS27 Kids' Knit Shape and Fit Outlook
summary: Knit shapes for SS27 kidswear: oversized T-shirts, striped tees, coordinated jersey sets, terry tops, swimwear and soft pyjamas.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body: Cozmo showed striped T-shirts and coordinated sets forming a total look, for newborns to 14 years<sup>[1]</sup>; Piupiuchick's terry top was in MilK's Dressing Idéal, with pyjamas from Oda London<sup>[2]</sup>; Cadhan showed organic cotton pyjamas<sup>[1]</sup>. Oversized T-shirts are among Fatamadrina's SS27 silhouettes<sup>[3]</sup>. Sport influence was "presented through a more refined, creative lens" at Playtime Paris<sup>[4]</sup>.

sections.heading: Shapes and fit
sections.body:
- **Oversized tee:** dropped shoulder, longer body.
- **Striped tee:** classic or boxy fit.
- **Jersey set:** tee or sweatshirt with shorts.
- **Terry top and shorts.**
- **Pyjamas:** close, comfortable fit for sleep.
- **Swim:** one-piece, two-piece, rash guard.

products: - Tees, sets, terry pieces, pyjamas, swimwear.
design_implications:
- In many markets, children's nightwear has its own flammability rules; check them before choosing loose-fitting pyjama shapes and fabrics.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist of young children's clothing, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, beads, shells and other decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Tees and sets are high-volume reorder lines.
